description: This bar chart, titled "Recall@10", illustrates the performance metric Recall@10 for four different methods or approaches labeled along the horizontal axis: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, scaled linearly from 0.1 to 0.4 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar corresponding to "Ours" is orange and reaches a value of approximately 0.35. The bar for "- critiquing" is blue and reaches approximately 0.3. The bar for "- scoring" is blue and reaches approximately 0.17. The bar for "- ranking" is blue and reaches approximately 0.23. All bars are presented in a single group without stacking or sub-grouping, and they are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis, not sorted by height. There are no visual emphasis or annotations on any of the bars.
